entries.before: Fifth narrower P2CG1 successor: accepted Task 14 group A2, the socket half, with dual doors keyed on the uninstalled port. CampaignHostRegistry gains the install-once typed ICampaignApplicationReceiptPort slot (set once, no uninstall outside _resetCampaignHostRegistry) and a per-entry graph-local launch: CampaignLaunchView | null built only when the port is installed. campaignProgressionReaders.durable exposes the launch-view factory, and CampaignProgressionGate owns the structural server-only readiness refusal caught after rollback. bindCampaignSyncConnection composes application from applicationReceipts ?? the registry port. Its three progression sites (the host AdvanceDay intent, the auto-approved proposal and the GM approval) take one of two paths. With entry.launch: prepare the P2CB view, take the P2CG1C progression reservation, run the P2CG1B guard inside the append, and translate a late refusal into CAMPAIGN_NOT_CONVERGED. Without it: the legacy session gate, unchanged. CampaignGmArbiter reserves and coalesces a pending AdvanceDay approval without deleting it or moving its timer or deadline; reservation validity reaches the pre-append guard; duplicate, authentication and recovery semantics are preserved. Tests install the port explicitly on a reset registry, as they pass applicationReceipts today; no test sets a boolean. The crossGraph test pins that a foreign-graph handle is refused context-mismatch. Activation predicate (frozen): a typed ICampaignApplicationReceiptPort installed once on CampaignHostRegistry by server.js at boot; the binder composes application from it, each entry derives a graph-local CampaignLaunchView from it, and both HTTP doors key on its presence while building their own graph-bound view; no other switch exists. Planned leaves (9): src/lib/multiplayer/server/CampaignProgressionGate.ts, src/lib/multiplayer/server/campaignProgressionReaders.durable.ts, src/lib/multiplayer/server/CampaignHostRegistry.ts, src/lib/multiplayer/server/bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts, src/lib/multiplayer/server/CampaignGmArbiter.ts and the tests __tests__/bindCampaignSyncConnection.test.ts, __tests__/CampaignGmArbiter.test.ts, __tests__/campaignProgressionReaders.durable.crossGraph.test.ts and __tests__/CampaignHostRegistry.test.ts under src/lib/multiplayer/server. CampaignMatchHost.ts and CampaignMatchHost.doors.ts, which the accepted A2 group also named, are P2CG1B leaves; if either must change again here, stop and use the successor procedure (this unit has one spare file). Estimated at about 195-255 counted lines with lifecycle; that is not a cap-fit proof.
